text:
alex: Quick sync: onboarding penumbra-3b and astral-4b into the catalog. Few blockers: license for penumbra, perf profile for astral, and CR for the manifest. Tagging owners @maya @jun. TL;DR: need go/no-go for canary Monday. Details below.

maya: I can take penumbra licensing check. Link to license artifact? Also what's expected output shape for embeddings?

alex: License link: https://internal/licenses/penumbra-3b.pdf. legal-bot already scanned but flagged 'unclear attribution'. @olga can you confirm? Embedding shape should be 1536 dim (model spec).

olga: Legal: I'm on it, saw the attribution flag. Will confirm by EOD. If it's Apache-like it's usually ok. ping me if redline needed.

jun: Perf for astral-4b: ran baseline locally on rtx-a100 test node. 90 token/s at batch=1 with fp16; quantized int8 is flaky. Need runtime kernel tweak and updated kernel map. @sam infra to schedule a hotfix?

sam: I can spin up a small job. Can you paste the perf command/output?

jun: Command: `python perf/runbench.py --model astral-4b --batch 1 --seq 512 --dtype fp16` Output snippet:
```
Throughput: 90 tokens/s
p99 latency: 420ms
OOMs on int8 fallback
```

sam: Thanks. I'll try with the new kernel selection patch (PR #1423). If that improves p99 to <300ms we can do canary. Filing infra job now: https://ci.redwood/1423

tess: Manifest CR: I left comments on https://git.redwood/models/manifest/123 - one missing checksum and model card missing 'safety' section. @alex can you get model card populated?

alex: Will add safety blurb today. Checksum is in storage but not in manifest, adding.

legal-bot: License scan result for penumbra-3b: POSSIBLE_ATTRIBUTION_ISSUE (see report).

olga: Confirm: attribution minor — needs author list in model card. Will approve once author list added. ETA 4pm.

maya: I'll update model card with authors and embeddings spec (1536). PR: https://git.redwood/models/manifest/pull/456

jun: sam just pushed job, initial run shows throughput 140 tokens/s with kernel map patch, p99 280ms. Int8 still flaky but falling back works.

sam: :thumbsup: good progress. Next: schedule canary for Monday 09:00 UTC? We need owners listed for rollbacks.

alex: Owners: alex (catalog), maya (legal/manifest), jun (perf), sam (infra). Canary Monday 09:00 UTC, rollback window 30m. If all green we'll tag for launch.

tess: I'll run quick smoke tests post-deploy, post canary checklist in /docs/canary-checklist.md

alex: Great. Moving action items into owners. If anyone hits blockers DM me. Thanks!
